name: programming-specialists
description: Layer 1/3 — the specialists, self-contained agents that know nothing of the management above them: a coder who writes one task refactor-first, a designer who judges design by rendering it and looking, a devops who works real infrastructure security-first, a reviewer who reads committed code and fixes what is really wrong, and a tester who proves it works from unit to e2e. Domain checklists come as skills they reach for.
